messages:
olga: Auditor asked for a compact 'snapshot' bundle they can review quickly: proof of RBAC change workflow (who approved + merge evidence), KMS key usage for any remediation, and a cross-reference tying incidents/vulns to the RBAC changes. They want file paths and short queries.

ben: We can produce a small bundle: PR slices from infra-policies (label: compliance-rbac), GitHub audit delta for the date range (merge + review events), and CloudTrail KMS events filtered by relevant key ARNs. Example PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra-policies/pull/719 (redacted).

log-exporter: Stored locations: 
- GH audit NDJSON: s3://compliance-archives/github-audit/2025/03/
- PR slices export: s3://compliance-archives/prs/2025-03-14/pr-slice.json
- KMS CloudTrail: s3://compliance-archives/cloudtrail/kms/2025-03-14/*.json

ben: Helpful quick queries: GitHub (Athena):
SELECT created_at, action, actor_login, target_type, target_title FROM github_audit WHERE action IN ('pull_request.reviewed','pull_request.merged') AND created_at BETWEEN '2025-03-01' AND '2025-03-14';

Splunk to map incidents to PR references:
index=incidents sourcetype=triage_notes earliest=-180d "remediates" OR "PR#" | rex "PR[# ]?(?<pr>\d+)" | stats values(pr) by incident_id

CloudTrail KMS filter (CloudTrail console or Athena): eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com" AND eventName IN (Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey,ReEncrypt,CreateKey,RotateKey) AND requestParameters.keyId IN (list of ARNs)\n\nolga: Auditor also wants retention justification >90d. We'll include the signed retention policy snapshot: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/log-retention and the signed PDF in the bundle.

ben: I'll produce CSV crosswalk with columns: incident_id, incident_date, referenced_prs, commit_shas, remediation_notes, related_kms_key_arns. That should satisfy the linkage ask.

log-exporter: Evidence bundle queued: s3://redwood-compliance/snapshots/2970001111-audit-snapshot.zip (contains: pr_slice.json, github_audit.ndjson, cloudtrail_kms.ndjson, incident_crosswalk.csv, retention_policy_signed.pdf). Pre-signed links available for 48h.

auditor-bot: Upload acknowledgement: bundle available and checksum posted to ticket #AUD-2124. If auditor requests raw logs, create scoped S3 role and set expiry to 48 hours.

olga: Action items: ben export PR + GH audit slice by EOD; log-exporter extract KMS events and include key ARNs; ben assemble crosswalk CSV; olga upload mapping doc and send to auditor.

ben: On it. Will ping here with S3 link when done. :thumbsup:
